page.overview:
What is Ghizguth?

Hziulquoigmnzhah (sibling) Tsathoggua (offspring)

Ghizguth (The Sound in the Deep Waters) is a fictional entity in the Cthulhu Mythos. The character first appeared in Clark Ashton Smith's family tree of Azathoth ("Genealogical Chart of the Elder Gods").

Ghizguth is one of the Great Old Ones. According to the Parchments of Pnom (Pnom being the chief Hyperborean genealogist as well as a noted prophet), he is a male spawn of Cxaxukluth and the brother of Hziulquoigmnzhah and Tulu. He is also the mate of Zstylzhemghi and the father of Tsathoggua. (: Selected Letters of Clark Ashton Smith)

For a long time, he lived alongside his family on Yuggoth, where he was revered by the Mi-Go (: "The Appeasement of Ghizguth"). However, at an unspecified point in time, they were discovered by his father, Cxaxukluth, who would eventually devour Zstylzhemghi (: "October Surprise").
